name: Luminescent Lowlands
description: Rolling plains of pastel low-poly grass dotted with glowing flora and gentle streams.

name: Prismatic Mesas
description: Tiered rock formations and geometric crystal outcroppings carving through orange-tinted valleys.

name: Void-Spire Range
description: Jagged obsidian spires and precipitous cliffs piercing the clouds above frozen abyss chasms.
